授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
The course is designed as group work and final presentation. The student will work on a topic about meat production, world food shortage and environmental problems.
All classes are given at Rm.220

Class 3 : June 17 (Wed) 16:40-18:10 Researching the topics and proposing
Class 4 : June 18 (Thr) 16:40-18:10  Group work
Class 5: June 19 (Fri) 16:40-18:10 Presentation preparation
Class  6, 7, 7.5 : June 25 (Thr) at 13:00-17:00 final presentation

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 本講義では世界の農学問題について考え解決策を提示することを授業目的とします。講義担当者は学生に食肉問題に関わるArticlesを提示し、授業学生はその中から問題を提起し解決策を探します。学生はグループにて調査内容をスライドにまとめプレゼンテーションを行います。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course is to think about agricultural meat problems in the world. The instructor provides the articles and　video information for the students so that they can pick research topics from there. The students research on the topics to propose ideas for solving the problems. The groups give the final presentation on the last day.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: The students in the graduate school of Bioresource and Bioenvironmental Sciences can take the course.
